info.title: REOS API
info.description: The REOS REST API used by the mobile app and partner integrations. Version 1 lives under `/api/v1`; breaking changes go to a new version (see ADR 0003).

put.description:
Use another role the person holds; this device remembers it, and
signing in again returns to it. Answers 422 with reason
`roles.errors.notHeld` for a role the person doesn't hold. Admin roles
can be chosen without two-step, but `permissions` stays empty and
`two_step.required` is true until it is set up.

get.description:
Public values only (Sentry DSN, PostHog project key), the same ones a
browser receives. `null` means the service is switched off.

Events overlapping the window, earliest first, plus where new events
go and any events deleted in your calendar tool that you can bring back.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the window, with time zone offset (the device's local midnight for "today").

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the window, after `from`, at most 62 days later.

post.description:
Saved at once and written to the calendar you chose (Connections ›
Manage); without one it stays in REOS.

put.description:
Events from a calendar shared as busy only, or one you can't edit,
can't be changed here.

delete.description:
Only events made in REOS; it's removed from the calendar tool too.
Restore undoes it.

post.description: Writes an event to the calendar tool again after writing failed.

Brings back the version that lost when an event changed in REOS and in
the calendar tool; it becomes the newest change. Returns the event, or
no content when undoing deleted it.

get.description:
The tools you may see, with what you can do with each. A status change
in the back office shows here at once, with no app release.

post.description: Counted as demand for the tool, so the most wanted are built first.

get.description: Yours, and your active organisation's when your role there manages it.

post.description: Queues a sync of every stream; the list shows the new time when it's done.

patch.description:
A new history range syncs again from its start; nothing already synced
is lost. Calendars also take which calendars to read (full, busy only
or off) and which one REOS's own events go to (screen 16).

delete.description:
REOS asks the tool to forget its access, then deletes the tokens and
everything it synced from this account.

get.description:
`features` lists what's active in my current state; `active` is false
when I have nothing paid or sponsored (the app shows the Membership
screen).

post.description:
The app opens `/auth/{google|apple}/redirect?app_challenge=…` in the
system browser. When the person has signed in, the browser returns to
`reos://auth?code=…`. Send that code with the PKCE verifier. Codes work
once, for two minutes.
post.summary: Swap a browser sign-in code for a device token

get.description:
Ten exam-style questions for the state, in `locale` (en or es), each
with its answer, explanation and source. No account needed.

post.description:
The free quiz is answered before sign-up and kept on the phone; the
app sends it here straight after the account is created.
post.summary: Save a quiz to my account

get.description:
Returns the application name, deployed version and server time.
Needs no authentication and never touches the database.

post.description:
Send the ID token the provider's SDK returned. Creates the account on
first sign-in, or joins an existing account with the same verified
email. Returns a bearer token for this device.
post.summary: Sign in with Google or Apple

get.description: Live courses for my current state, with their lessons.

Finds passages in the lessons of my live courses (keyword and, when
switched on, meaning). Each opens at its heading, page or second.

Its text by heading, slides and documents page by page (with a signed
link to the file), the video (Mux `hls` with a signed token, or the
original `file`) and its captions with timings. Links last two hours.
404 unless the lesson is in a live course for my current state; 402
(`membership_required`) when it needs a plan I don't have yet (each
course's first lesson is free).

get.summary: List my licences, live states first

post.description:
Checks the number with the state's regulator. A match in your name
counts at once (`check: verified`); a different name, a state with no
check yet, or (with `review: true`) a number the regulator doesn't have
goes to a reviewer. Without `review`, an unknown number is refused (422).

Looks the number up with the state's regulator without saving it, so
the person sees the name, type, status and expiry first. Adding it
(`POST /me/licences`) checks again.

get.description:
The requirement for the current period comes from the state's rules
in force today (each part names its source), less completed CE. Null
when the state has no CE rules yet.
get.summary: What CE this licence still needs

patch.summary: Set who you supervise (changes your CE)

delete.description:
Signs out every device now and deletes the account after 30 days;
signing in again before then keeps it. Needs a sign-in from the last
15 minutes: otherwise answers 403 with reason
`identity.errors.recentSignInRequired`, and the app asks the person to
sign in again first.

get.summary: List the devices signed in to this account

delete.description:
Use the current device's id to sign out here, or another id to sign
out a lost or old phone.

put.description:
Send only what changed. Choosing `become_agent` makes the person a
candidate. `complete: true` marks the setup done, so the chooser and
setup don't show again.

post.description:
Texts a six-digit code to the number, valid for 10 minutes. Limited per
number and per network to stop abuse.

Creates the account on first sign-in. Five wrong codes lock the number
for 15 minutes.
post.summary: Check the code and sign in

get.description: Live states first. The super admin decides which are live.

post.description:
Once per person, or per device before an account exists. Members are
told the day the state opens.

get.description:
Open ones (the default) by due date, undated last; `status=done` for
finished ones, newest first; `status=all` for both.

post.description:
Send the phone's own `client_id`: sending the same one again returns
the to-do already saved (200) instead of adding another (201).

post.summary: Mark done (from the app or the reminder's Done button)

post.description:
Returns to-dos for the confirm card: titles, notes, people's names to
match against your contacts, due times in your time zone and whether
to remind. Claude reads it when AI is set up and you have credits (one
per parse); otherwise the built-in parser does. Nothing said is stored.

role.description: One of the roles the person holds (see `roles` in `GET /me`).

organisation_id.description: The organisation that role is held in.

AddLicenceRequest.description: "Add a licence" (agent journey screen 149, web screen 23): a state and the licence number.

state.description: The state's two-letter code, for example `TX`.

number.description: The licence number as the regulator shows it.

anyOf.description: Used only when the regulator can't be checked; the regulator's record wins.
Who they supervise, if anyone (changes their CE).

review.description: Send it to a reviewer when the regulator has no such licence.

AddLicenceRequest.title: AddLicenceRequest

environment.description: Server environment, used to tag errors and events.

sentry.description: Error tracking, or `null` when switched off.

posthog.description: Product analytics, or `null` when switched off.

sign_in.description:
Which sign-in buttons to show. `demo` means Google and Apple run
on demo data: sign in through the browser's persona picker.

BrokerRole.description: Supervising duties that change a licence's CE (A5.2): in Texas, Broker Responsibility is required for brokers who sponsor agents, designated brokers of sponsoring entities and delegated supervisors (22 TAC §535.92(a)(4)).
BrokerRole.title: BrokerRole

title.description: Null for an event from a calendar shared as busy only.

end_date.description: All-day events: the last day, inclusive.

busy.description: From a calendar shared as busy only: times and nothing else.

source.description: `reos` when made in REOS, otherwise the tool's register id.

tool.description: The tool it lives in now ("Google Calendar"), or null when only in REOS.

calendar.description: The calendar it lives in at the tool.

editable.description: It can be changed in REOS (not busy only, and the calendar allows it).

deletable.description: Only events made in REOS can be deleted from REOS.

sync.description:
`synced` (in step with the tool), `pending` (being written),
`failed` (not written; Try again) or `local` (only in REOS).

sync_error.description: Translation key for why writing failed.

conflict.description: Changed in REOS and in the tool: which version was kept, and the other one, which Undo brings back.

CalendarMode.description:
What REOS does with one of the person's calendars (Connections and Sync journey, screen 16). | | |---| | `full`
Events are read, and changes made in REOS go back. | | `busy`
Only the times are read, shown as "Busy": no title, place or guests. | | `off`
Not read at all. |
CalendarMode.title: CalendarMode

id.description: The tool's register id, for example `follow-up-boss`.

purpose.description:
The agent-facing line in their language; the register checks every
tool people can see has one.

category.description: The register category, for example `crm` or `transactions` (the website's tabs).

status.description:
`enabled`, `beta`, `coming_soon`, `paused` (temporarily unavailable) or `retired`. | | |---| | `enabled`
Connect / Manage. | | `beta`
Selected organisations connect; others can ask to join. | | `coming_soon`
Shown with "Notify me"; taps are counted to prioritise the build. | | `paused`
Kill switch: "Temporarily unavailable". Data is kept; syncing stops. | | `retired`
Shown with its end date, then removed. |

action.description:
What this person can do: `connect`, `join_beta`, `notify`,
`ask_broker` (a tool their brokerage sets up once for everyone) or `none`.

interested.description: They tapped "Notify me", "Join beta" or "Ask my broker".

retires_on.description: Retired tools: the last day they work (YYYY-MM-DD).

connected.description: How many accounts of theirs are connected.

consent.description: For tools that can be connected: what REOS will be able to do, and what it never does (consent sheet).

CatalogueStatus.description:
What people see for a tool (web journey screen 64): the register's `launch` value until the super admin changes it. | | |---| | `enabled`
Connect / Manage. | | `beta`
Selected organisations connect; others can ask to join. | | `coming_soon`
Shown with "Notify me"; taps are counted to prioritise the build. | | `paused`
Kill switch: "Temporarily unavailable". Data is kept; syncing stops. | | `retired`
Shown with its end date, then removed. |
CatalogueStatus.title: CatalogueStatus

CheckLicenceRequest.description: Look a licence number up before adding it (agent journey screen 149).

state.description: The state's two-letter code, for example `TX`.

CheckLicenceRequest.title: CheckLicenceRequest

state.description: One of the person's live states, for example `TX`.

integration.description: The tool's register id, for example `google-calendar`.

account.description: The account at the tool, usually its email.

status.description:
`active`, `reconnect_needed` or `failing`. | | |---| | `active`
Syncing normally. | | `reconnect_needed`
The tool refused the sign-in (revoked, expired, or REOS switched run mode): the person must sign in again. | | `failing`
Syncs keep failing for another reason; REOS keeps retrying. |

demo.description: Running on demo data (the Simulator), not the real tool.

scopes.description: What REOS may do at the tool.

history.description: How far back the first sync reached: `3m`, `12m` or `all`.

problem.description: Translation key for the latest problem, or null.

problem_since.description: When the latest problem started (for "stopped 2 days ago").

streams.description: What syncs: each stream, which way, and how many records came over.

calendars.description: Calendars only (screen 16): each calendar, how REOS reads it, and whether REOS's events go there.

ConnectionStatus.description:
Where a connection stands, as the person sees it. | | |---| | `active`
Syncing normally. | | `reconnect_needed`
The tool refused the sign-in (revoked, expired, or REOS switched run mode): the person must sign in again. | | `failing`
Syncs keep failing for another reason; REOS keeps retrying. |
ConnectionStatus.title: ConnectionStatus

code.description: The one-time code the browser returned to the app with.

code_verifier.description: The PKCE verifier the app created before opening the browser.

status.description: Always `ok` when the application can serve requests.

HistoryRange.description: How far back the first sync reaches: 3 or 12 months, or everything.
HistoryRange.title: HistoryRange

IdentityProvider.description: One-tap sign-in providers, and their entries in the integrations register.
IdentityProvider.title: IdentityProvider

id_token.description: The ID token the Google or Apple SDK returned on the phone.

name.description: Apple shares the person's name only on their first sign-in; the app passes it on.

page.description: Page of the slides or document to open at.

seconds.description: Second of the video to start at.

LibraryGroup.description: The tabs of the Connections library (Connections and Sync journey, screens 2–4).
LibraryGroup.title: LibraryGroup

holder_name.description: The name on the regulator's record.

verified_by.description: `simulator`, `trec-licence` or `reviewer`; null while waiting for review.

review_note.description: Why it's waiting for review, or why it was rejected.

tracked_only.description: The state isn't live yet: tracked for renewal only.

ce.description:
CE this period ("9 of 18 h") and what's still needed, from the
state's rules in force today (A5.2); null while waiting for
review, or when the state has no CE rules.

LicenceRoleRequest.description: Who a licence holder supervises (A5.1); changes their CE (A5.2).
LicenceRoleRequest.title: LicenceRoleRequest

LicenceType.description: A real estate licence (A5.1). Designated brokers and delegated supervisors are a `BrokerRole`.
LicenceType.title: LicenceType

Locale.description: Languages REOS is available in. Matches `supportedLocales` in packages/i18n.
Locale.title: Locale

name.description: Null until the person gives it (phone sign-ups give it in setup).

sign_in_methods.description: How this person can sign in.

roles.description:
Every role the person holds, each in an organisation. Admin
roles need two-step before they grant anything.

active_role.description: The role in use on this device; null for someone with no role yet.

permissions.description: What the active role allows, such as `learning.study`.

states.description:
The live states the person works in and the one in use (A5.1).
The switcher shows when there is more than one option.

onboarding.description: Path, target state and setup choices from getting started (A3.3).

enabled.description: An authenticator app or a passkey is set up.

required.description: The active role is an admin role that needs two-step first.

admin.description: Admin roles need two-step before they grant anything.

OnboardingPath.description:
The cards on "Choose your path" (mobile journey screen 1). | | |---| | `become_agent`
| | `licensed_agent`
| | `broker`
Broker, team and association set-up finishes on the website. | | `instructor`
| | `provider`
|
OnboardingPath.title: OnboardingPath

state.description: Two-letter code of a live state.

reminder_time.description: HH:MM, or null for no reminder.

complete.description: True when "Build my plan" is tapped: the setup won't show again.

anyOf.description:
The card chosen on "Choose your path"; null before choosing. | | |---| | `become_agent`
| | `licensed_agent`
| | `broker`
Broker, team and association set-up finishes on the website. | | `instructor`
| | `provider`
|

exam_month.description: The month they plan to take the exam (YYYY-MM); null means "Not sure".

reminder_time.description: Daily reminder (HH:MM), or null for none.

completed.description: The 60-second setup is done, so the chooser and setup never show again.

days_to_exam.description: Days until the start of the exam month.

qualifying_hours.description: Qualifying education the state asks for (180 in Texas).

OrganisationType.description:
Kinds of organisation (tenant) a role can belong to (A3.2, A4.1). | | |---| | `platform`
REOS itself: super admins, and people who joined on their own. | | `brokerage`
| | `school`
| | `association`
| | `provider_business`
A lender, inspector, title company or other service business. | | `team`
A team inside a brokerage (its parent); it inherits the brokerage's plan. |
OrganisationType.title: OrganisationType

ParseVoiceRequest.description: What someone said, to turn into to-dos (B4.3).

text.description: The words, as the phone's speech recognition heard them.

timezone.description: The phone's time zone, for example `America/Chicago`.

said_at.description: When it was said, if not just now (a capture queued while offline).

ParseVoiceRequest.title: ParseVoiceRequest

code.description: The six-digit code from the text message.

state.description: The state the quiz was taken for.

answers.description: Each answer given before sign-up, kept on the phone until now.

source.description: Where the answer comes from: a rule, statute or exam outline topic.

sample.description: A sample question (until the licensed question bank arrives).

topics.description: Each topic: strong, learning or start_here.

QuizTopic.description: Exam topics from the licensing content outline, as quiz questions are tagged.
QuizTopic.title: QuizTopic

Role.description: The roles from the journey documents, plus the platform's super admin. A person can hold several, each in an organisation.
Role.title: Role

SaveCalendarEventRequest.description:
An appointment made or changed in REOS ("New appointment" sheet). Timed
events send `starts_at` and `ends_at`; all-day events send `start_date`
and `end_date` (the last day, inclusive).

starts_at.description: Start, with its time zone offset (timed events).

notify_guests.description: Let the calendar email the guests an invitation. Off unless asked: REOS never sends messages for you.

SaveCalendarEventRequest.title: SaveCalendarEventRequest

SaveTodoRequest.description:
A to-do from the confirm card or typed in (B4.3). Due at a moment
(`due_at`, with offset) or on a day (`due_date`), not both.

client_id.description: The phone's own id for this to-do (a UUID), so sending it twice saves it once.

due_at.description: Due at this moment, with its offset.

remind_at.description: When the phone reminds; at or before nothing in particular, but not in the far past.

related_type.description: The person it's about: `phone_contact` (the phone's own contact id) for now.

related_label.description: Their name, as shown on the to-do.

SaveTodoRequest.title: SaveTodoRequest

token.description: Bearer token for this device. Keep it in secure storage.

new_device.description: True when this person had never signed in on this device before.

new_account.description: True when this sign-in created the account (show the 60-second setup).

StartConnectionRequest.description: Start connecting a tool: which one, and how much history the first sync fetches.

integration.description: The tool's register id, for example `google-calendar`.

anyOf.description: How far back the first sync reaches: `3m` (default), `12m` or `all`.

StartConnectionRequest.title: StartConnectionRequest

live.description: People can register and study for this state now; otherwise "Coming soon" with a waitlist.

waiting.description: People waiting for this state to open.

StateStatus.description:
Where a state is in its launch (web journey screen 61). | | |---| | `live`
People can register and study for this state. | | `in_preparation`
Rules, courses and approvals are being loaded. | | `waitlist`
Not being prepared yet; people can join the waitlist. | | `not_planned`
|
StateStatus.title: StateStatus

client_id.description: The phone's own id for it, when it made it.

due_at.description: Due at this moment (ISO 8601), or null.

due_date.description: Due on this day (`YYYY-MM-DD`), when it has no time.

calendar_event_id.description: The calendar event its due date made, if any.

name.description: The tool's name, as the person knows it.

UpdateConnectionRequest.description: "What to sync" (Connections and Sync journey, screens 7 and 16).

history.description: How far back to sync: `3m`, `12m` or `all`.

calendars.description: Calendars only: each calendar id → `full` (read and write), `busy` (times only) or `off`.

write_calendar.description: Calendars only: where events made in REOS go, or an empty string to keep them in REOS.

UpdateConnectionRequest.title: UpdateConnectionRequest

device_id.description: The app's device id, so the same phone joins once before an account exists.

email.description: To be told the day the state opens (optional on the phone).

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
